headwords: khéo ăn thì no, khéo co thì ấm

flags.why: “Khái luận” names an introductory overview or discussion, rather than the action of outlining ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/kh%C3%A1i%20lu%E1%BA%ADn%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
flags.fix: noun | introductory overview; general discussion of a subject

flags.why: The example incorrectly uses “khái luận” as a verb.
flags.fix: Giáo sư viết một bài khái luận về văn học. = The professor wrote an introductory overview of literature.

flags.why: This academic word needs a formal register warning ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/kh%C3%A1i%20lu%E1%BA%ADn%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
“Khái lược” belongs to formal written usage rather than ordinary casual speech ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/khai-luoc-eSlt6myzfpHK3.html)).
The example defines the bird instead of showing the name in use.
flags.fix: Tôi thấy một con khát nước đậu trên cành cây. = I saw a chestnut-winged cuckoo perched on a branch.

flags.why: The meaning about children suffering for their parents' actions belongs to the whole proverb, not independently to “khát nước”.
flags.fix: Remove this separate sense and place the proverb under “Đời cha ăn mặn, đời con khát nước”.

flags.why: The established figurative sense concerns continuing to gamble after losing, rather than generally pushing one's luck ([dictionary](https://lehboi.github.io/download/VNTD-KTTD/TDKTTD_KH.pdf)).
flags.fix: to keep gambling after losses in an attempt to win them back

flags.why: The example about an annoyed boss does not illustrate the gambling sense.
flags.fix: Anh ta đánh bạc khát nước, càng thua càng đánh. = He kept gambling to recover his losses, betting more the more he lost.

flags.why: The gloss presents a political insult targeting overseas Vietnamese as an ordinary description of homesickness ([usage](https://baotreonline.com/tre_assets/uploads/2025/11/1480-dallas.pdf)).
flags.fix: a political taunt directed at overseas Vietnamese associated with the former South Vietnam, punning on being thirsty and having lost one's country

flags.why: This use can disparage overseas Vietnamese and requires an explicit derogatory warning ([dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/kh%C3%A1t_n%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Bc)).
The example explains what an ideal gas is instead of using the term in a situation.
flags.fix: Trong bài tập này, ta coi không khí là khí lí tưởng. = In this exercise, we treat air as an ideal gas.

flags.why: The example defines a barometer by its function instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Anh ấy kiểm tra khí áp kế trước khi ra khơi. = He checked the barometer before heading out to sea.
